name: Tire Flip
steps: Face the tire with feet apart, bend your hips and knees, and press your shoulders against the tread.
Slide your hands under the edge and brace your trunk with your arms extended.
Drive forward and up with your legs until the tire starts to tip upright.
Change to a palms-forward grip and push the tire away from you.
Let the tire settle on the floor before approaching it again.
tips: Keep your arms straight during the initial lift and drive with your legs rather than curling the heavy tire with your biceps.
Maintain a flat back throughout the initial pull to protect your lower spine.
